fixtures.request: This invoice function is painful to change. Plan a cleanup that keeps the printed output exactly the same. I have about two days.
input: billing/invoice.py (fictional Copperleaf Print Shop):
def format_invoice(order):
lines = []
for item in order.items:
amount = round(item.price * item.qty, 2)
lines.append(f'{item.name:<30}{amount:>10.2f}')
subtotal = 0
for item in order.items:
subtotal += int(item.price * item.qty * 100) / 100
lines.append(f'{"Subtotal":<30}{subtotal:>10.2f}')
if order.customer.country == 'home':
lines.append(f'{"Delivery":<30}{4.50:>10.2f}')
# ... 60 more lines of the same pattern for tax, credits and footer
return '\n'.join(lines)
